feeds.title: Every Last Bite
feeds.description: Welcome, I'm Carmen! I am a passionate foodie who was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease and found remission through clean eating. My mission is to show others that no matter how restrictive your diet you can still make delicious food that everyone will love.

feeds.title: Happy Gut For Life
feeds.description: Recipes and information about the Specific Carbohydrate Diet., gluten-free, grain-free, and sugar-free eating for helping to manage digestive issues. Companion to the blog Happy Gut for Life.

feeds.title: Jane's Healthy Kitchen » SCD & GAPS Diets
feeds.description: Hi!! I'm Jane, a gluten-free, Paleo chef, health practitioner, and author of Paleo Desserts. This blog is for you and every-body, especially for special diets.

feeds.title: The No Gluten Girl
feeds.description: Hi! I'm The No Gluten Girl. Whether you're navigating a new diagnosis, a lifestyle change, or looking for the ultimate gluten-free recipe inspiration- you've come to the right place. I love sharing my experiences and my recipes with you - to help you know that you're not alone.

feeds.title: ThirtySomethingSuperMom
feeds.description: I'm a blogger based in Iowa who loves to cook, create, and travel with my family. I like to share unique travel destinations, healthy versions of traditional recipes, and homemaking tips but you can find a variety of useful articles throughout the site.

feeds.title: Danielle Walker's Blog
feeds.description: Author of the New York Times Best Selling cookbook Against all Grain, Danielle Walker provides recipes that are grain-free, refined sugar-free, and lactose-free. Perfect for Paleo, Gluten-Free, SCD, and GAPS.

feeds.title: Kim Braly RD Blog
feeds.description: Advanced Nutrition Therapy for Crohn's Disease, IBD & Ulcerative colitis

feeds.title: Danielle Walker Blog
feeds.description: Danielle Walker's recipes feature delicious and nutritious recipes for a variety of diets, including gluten-free, dairy-free, and paleo. From breakfast to dessert, find easy-to-follow recipes that will satisfy your cravings and nourish your body. Discover the joy of cooking with wholesome ingredients and make every meal a tasty and healthy experience.

feeds.title: Wholesomely Hannah
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Hannah! I love creating fun healthy recipes, distance running, and sharing little pieces of early life! I wanted to make this channel to focus on how I'm healing my chronic disease through food, pieces of my everyday life, and specific carbohydrate diet/ paleo-based recipe videos. I'm excited to share little clips of my life and connect with you all!

feeds.title: SCD Recipes Blog
feeds.description: Here at SCD Recipes blog I am sharing my unique perspective on travel and highlighting all of the interesting experiences I have all over the country and various recipes.

feeds.title: Comfy Belly » SCD Recipes
feeds.description: Grain-free, gluten-free, SCD recipes for health and happiness from a cookbook author, mom, and writer comfy belly. Recipes that support the Specific Carbohydrate Diet (SCD) and GAPS Protocol.
